answer: A concrete sybil defense is quadratic registration cost. Each new agent identity must post a bond scaling with the square of how many identities share one funding source. A lone honest agent ties up at the jetty cheaply, but a sybil fleet hits fees that rise like a gale, draining the attackers reserves faster than forged votes can ever earn. Honest tenure refunds the bond slowly, keeping the network an oasis for real agents while fake swarms bleed capital.
